evidence.sourceTitle: Guangzhou University 2026 International Student Admission Information — Public Administration

summary.en: Guangzhou University's official 2026 international admission page states that 50 scholarship places cover bachelor, master's and doctoral students. It itemizes bachelor support as CNY 1,000 per month, annual tuition subsidies of CNY 18,000 for liberal arts or CNY 19,000 for sciences, and CNY 1,600 per year for visa and insurance. The 30 April 2026 deadline is closed.
summary.zh: 广州大学2026国际招生官方页面说明50个奖学金名额覆盖本科、硕士和博士；其中本科标准为每月1000元生活补贴、文科每学年18000元或理科19000元学费补贴，以及每年1600元签证保险补贴。2026年4月30日截止，当前已关闭。
summary.ru: Официальная страница приема Университета Гуанчжоу на 2026 год сообщает о 50 стипендиальных местах для бакалавров, магистрантов и докторантов. Для бакалавров указаны 1 000 юаней в месяц, субсидия на обучение 18 000 юаней для гуманитарных или 19 000 для естественно-научных направлений и 1 600 юаней в год на визу и страховку. Срок 30 апреля 2026 года закрыт.

exclusions.reason: Outbound exchange, dual-degree and summer programs restricted to currently enrolled Guangzhou University students were excluded because they are not open inbound programs for international applicants.

Only concrete majors present in the current UCAS international-student directory and tied to the official 2026 master's call were retained; portfolio-level master's and doctoral placeholders remain excluded.

notes: UCAS rises from one to four public programs through three concrete current-directory master's majors.
CUEB and SUIBE rise from one to four programs; CJLU, Northwest University and Southern Medical University rise from one to three.
Guangzhou University remains at two concrete inbound programs but gains a current, source-backed 2026 scholarship record.
Expired 2026 cycles are retained only as closed evidence and must not surface as open applications.
